JioHotstar Benchmarks Knowledge Bases for AI Coding Agents
items.summary: JioHotstar evaluated 6 approaches to code retrieval for AI coding agents using SWE, CodeScale Bench, and an internal question-answering harness. Structural search performed well on concrete tasks, whi...
items.description: JioHotstar evaluated 6 approaches to code retrieval for AI coding agents using SWE, CodeScale Bench, and an internal question-answering harness. Structural search performed well on concrete tasks, while semantic retrieval helped with ambiguous requirements. The findings highlight trade-offs in accuracy, token use, and tool design, underscoring the need to match retrieval tools to task types.

items.description: This article describes the investigation to find the root cause of a production crash in a large-scale iOS consumer app that had no clean stack trace. The final code change was small, but identifying the root cause required turning a vague SIGBUS report into a controlled set of experiments. By Abhishek Gang Deb

items.title: Article: LLM Reliability Layers Under Test: Accuracy, Yield, and the Limits of Verification
items.summary: Verification layers sort outputs by trust rather than fixing errors. In a benchmark of six reliability layers, voting and self-correction failed to recover accuracy - they only withheld doubtful recor...
items.description: Verification layers sort outputs by trust rather than fixing errors. In a benchmark of six reliability layers, voting and self-correction failed to recover accuracy - they only withheld doubtful records. Production systems gain more reliability by replacing generation with deterministic lookups, tracking yield over raw accuracy, and resolving extraction bottlenecks before stacking checks.
